prompts.environment:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production environment sprite ATLAS for CodeMap, an original browser 2D fantasy RPG. Generate ONE transparent PNG atlas, landscape 2:1 aspect, ideally 2048x1024. EXACTLY 4 equal columns and 2 equal rows, eight separate equal square cells, no drawn grid or labels. Each object completely contained in its cell with generous transparent padding, no overlap. This is a usable game sprite sheet, NOT a scene or promotional montage.
Shared style: attractive clean pre-rendered low-poly diorama miniatures; elevated three-quarter overhead view about 55 degrees downward, orthographic camera, north upward, hand-crafted faceted geometry, soft warm sunlight from upper left, restrained soft contact shadows, crisp readable silhouettes, moss and sage greens, warm honey wood, blue-grey stone, turquoise accents. Original designs. No pixel art, photorealism, outlines, text, watermark, background terrain or square platforms. Genuine alpha transparency around each prop.
ROW 1 left to right: (1) one broadleaf tree with full layered faceted green crown and visible brown trunk/roots; (2) one tall tiered pine tree with layered dark green polygonal foliage and visible trunk; (3) a compact low mossy blue-grey boulder cluster, roughly twice as wide as tall; (4) a small cozy fantasy academy building, moss-green teal gabled roof, warm plaster and oak beams, golden lit window, a front door facing bottom of image, building complete including roof, no ground platform.
ROW 2 left to right: (5) a wooden footbridge viewed overhead with travel direction EXACTLY horizontal left-to-right, deck aligned horizontally, two railings along top and bottom, rectangular footprint, no water; (6) an upright small blue-grey rune standing stone with one simple glowing turquoise abstract rune shape, no writing, set on small stone foot; (7) a low natural clump of grass with small lavender and yellow flowers, no pot; (8) a low wide cluster of fallen angular stone rubble, no plants, suitable for a removable landslide.
Match perspective and lighting across all eight objects. Tree foliage and building should fill at most 85% cell height. Alpha edges clean, no checkerboard pattern.
prompts.characters:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production CHARACTER SPRITE ATLAS for original educational fantasy RPG CodeMap. Generate ONE square transparent PNG ideally 2048x2048, EXACTLY FOUR equal columns and FOUR equal rows. Each of the 16 equal square cells is independent; NO grid lines, NO labels, NO text, NO watermark, NO ground/platform/base. Genuine transparent alpha background. No character may overlap another cell. Fully show each subject with ample clear padding. Each character occupies roughly the middle 70% of its cell, standing feet at 85% of cell height.
Style: coherent pre-rendered low-poly storybook fantasy miniatures, faceted modeled shapes, simple readable attractive faces, slightly oversized heads, soft warm upper-left sunlight, elevated 55-degree three-quarter overhead orthographic camera, sage greens, honey-brown leather, muted teal cloth, blue-grey stone. Not photorealistic, not pixel art. Keep shapes readable as small 2D game sprites. Neutral idle poses, full body.
Row1: four views of EXACTLY THE SAME young adult adventurer (gender-neutral), short chestnut hair, a teal hooded cloak worn hood down, cream tunic, brown boots, satchel and short wooden staff. Cell1 facing screen-bottom (front). Cell2 facing screen-top (back). Cell3 facing screen-left (left side). Cell4 facing screen-right (right side). Same outfit, proportions and scale across all four.
Row2: Cell1 Eldren, elderly male arcanist with short white beard, purple robes, small purple pointed hat and wooden crystal staff. Cell2 Brann, broad male village guard with auburn beard, warm rust-colored tunic, simple leather armor, small round shield. Cell3 Mira, female mountain engineer with dark braided hair, ochre coat, work gloves, compact hammer. Cell4 Lyra, female forest warden with green cloak, dark brown hair and simple wooden bow. All face mostly screen-bottom.
Row3: Cell1 Neria, female rune scholar with silver-blue cloak, short dark hair and turquoise crystal orb. Cell2 Tala, female nature researcher, curly auburn hair, sage green coat, small botanical satchel and notebook. Cell3 MOOSLING, a small original friendly round moss creature with two leafy ears, short root feet, green faceted moss body, tiny yellow flowers, big kind dark eyes, NO armor or shield. Cell4 GLUTLING, small original friendly orange ember salamander, cream belly, big dark eyes, tiny horns, short feet and curved tail ending in a flame; no wings.
Row4: Cell1 FELSBOCK, small sturdy friendly ram creature, chunky blue-grey stone body with mossy patches, curled stone horns, four strong short legs, warm eyes, clearly distinct from Moosling. Cell2 training construct, small stocky wooden-and-stone practice golem, faceted grey body, wooden braces, glowing soft turquoise core, non-scary. Cell3 and Cell4 COMPLETELY EMPTY transparent cells.
All fourteen subjects have consistent camera, light and rendering. Do not add decorative scenery, lettering, symbols, or background.
prompts.grass: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless repeating ground texture for original CodeMap low-poly fantasy RPG. One square 1024x1024 opaque top-down orthographic grass texture, all four edges seamlessly tileable. Quiet moss/sage/meadow green palette harmonizing with warm low-poly diorama sprites, small simplified faceted patches of soft grass and moss. Flat ground surface viewed directly from above, absolutely no horizon, perspective, platforms, borders, paths, rocks, trees, flowers, characters, text, symbols or shadows from unseen objects. Keep contrast LOW and the pattern naturally varied without conspicuous repeating clusters so small game characters and sandy paths remain readable. Soft warm ambient daylight. This is a functional uniform terrain texture, NOT a landscape illustration.
